utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can make it at 7. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just your company is enough. Maybe a mug of tea if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do that. Tea sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but only if we pin down the time and who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and who’s bringing what before I say yes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the time and the list of who’s bringing what before I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club. I think I missed the last update - are we still meeting this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think so - unless I mixed up the day again. Let me check and I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, let me know what you find — I don’t want to miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that book club plan again, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks. I can use the help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with the book club plan again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what did I miss about the book club?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not much, just that we’re reading the first half and meeting next week to talk it over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll catch up on the first half and be there next week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s set a time and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can send a quick invite and pick a simple time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, a simple time works for me. Send the invite and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we meeting at the library or at your place for book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s do the library this time—it’s easier for everyone, and I can bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club? I heard they picked a good one this month - want me to tell you what I know?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, tell me where it is and I'll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Maple, just past the library. I can give you the room number too if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa. I’ll make sure to bring the book club notes and check who wants to host next time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara. I’ll jot down the notes and keep an eye on who wants to host next time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll bring the notes and we can see who’s up for hosting next time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over some tea and check whether anyone’s keeping notes for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, tea sounds good. I’ll ask around for the notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the tea and keep an ear out for the notes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club's been lively lately - I heard they picked a really good one this month.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a good pick. I might have to ask what they chose.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard it’s a mystery this time, and people are already arguing over the ending.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I sign up, which day is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Thursday after school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll be there Thursday after school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can make it if you send the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll send you the time and place shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can make the book club meeting this week if Jules still wants to pick the next book.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’d love that. I can pick the next book and bring a couple of options to the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds great, I’ll bring my schedule and we can pick together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. Did we decide on the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, but I can check my notes and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, just let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't heard much about it yet, but I'd be curious to know what kind of book club it is.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s usually pretty relaxed, just a small group picking one book at a time and talking it over. I can ask around and see what they’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. Let me know what they’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d be glad to help with the book club, Opal. What day works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Saturday afternoon works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Saturday afternoon works for me too. Would you like to meet at my place or the library?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I need to know the time and place so I can check if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s at my place this Thursday at 7. I’ll send you the address now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, send the address and I’ll see if Thursday works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the book club meeting is still on for tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, see you tonight then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can make Tuesday work if we keep it simple. Just let me know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Tuesday works for me too. What time and place were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: How about 7 p.m. at the library? That should keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club might be meeting soon, but I missed the details. Did you know when it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think it’s next Thursday evening at the library, but I’d want to double-check before you plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll check with you before I go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club. I almost forgot — what time were we meeting again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We said 7 o'clock at my place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, 7 at your place. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that book club schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, what time should I tell people to arrive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: People can arrive around 6:30, and we can start right at 6:45.
